title: The elements of art
examples: What is the difference between shape and form?
Can you show me an example of line in nature?
How does colour affect the feeling of a picture?

explain.say: Today we learn about the elements of art. These are the basic building blocks of all art.

items: Colour: What we see with our eyes

draw.text: Elements of Art: Line, Shape, Colour

explain.say: A line can be straight, curved, or zig-zag. Look at this drawing of a fence.
A shape is an area that is flat on a surface. Think about a simple circle.

draw.text: Shape: Flat area on a surface

explain.say: Colour is what makes art bright and exciting. We talk about warm and cool colours.
Texture is how something feels or looks like it feels. Think about rough bark or soft fur.

draw.text: Texture: How it feels or looks

explain.say: Space is the area around and within objects in art. It gives the piece depth.

items: Negative Space: The empty area around it

faq.q: What is the difference between shape and form?
faq.a: A shape is flat, like drawing on paper. A form has depth, like a ball you can hold.
asks: What is the difference between flat and solid art?

faq.q: Does colour change the meaning of art?
faq.a: Yes, colours can make you feel happy or calm. For example, bright yellow feels energetic.
Value is how light or dark a colour is. It helps create shadows and highlights in your drawing.
asks: What is light and dark in art?
How do I make my drawing look 3D?

faq.q: Is texture always about touching it?
faq.a: No, texture can be implied. Artists can paint something to look rough even if it is smooth.

faq.q: What is the most important element to remember?
faq.a: All elements are important because they work together. They are like different instruments in a band.
asks: Do I need all the elements?

facts: Line is the path connecting two points.
Shape is two dimensional, meaning it has length and width.
Form is three dimensional, meaning it has length, width, and depth.
Value refers to the lightness or darkness of a colour.

quiz.say: If you paint a patch that is very light yellow next to a very dark blue, you are showing contrast in:
quiz.why: Value is specifically about how light or dark the colour appears.

wrong.1: Colour is the name, like blue or yellow, not the lightness.
wrong.2: Shape describes the outline, not the light level.
wrong.3: Texture describes how it feels, not how light it is.

quiz.say: A drawing of a coiled snake uses which element to suggest its body wrapping around?
quiz.why: The snake’s body is defined by the continuous path of the line.

wrong.0: While it has form, the defining characteristic shown is the curving line.
wrong.2: Shape would only show the snake if it was completely flat.
wrong.3: Space is the empty area, not the snake itself.
